title: CoInverseBenchmark+ / CoNextGeneration+ / CoLatch+
purpose: Build reciprocal, independent challenge and voluntary intergenerational continuity while reducing dependence on founders, chat sessions, or any single AI.
principles: No actor or model self-certifies: require independently sourced reciprocal challenge.
No crown: founders, stewards, assistants and successors retain bounded, revocable authority.
The next generation inherits options, not duties; consent, age-appropriate autonomy, privacy, and refusal are primary.
Public narrative is a consent-filtered projection; never publish a child's identity, private history, or inferred preferences by default.
Human agency is not a dependency to optimize away: remove mechanical relay, preserve meaningful choice.
Distinct experimental waves maximize coverage and novelty; matched controls preserve reproducibility.
Spiritual or G_dSide interpretations are welcome as labeled philosophical or belief lanes, not empirical certifications.

benchmark_matrix.measure: successful independent recovery without originating session
benchmark_matrix.challenge: new reader with no chat context

benchmark_matrix.measure: material errors found by independent challengers
handoff completed without founder as messenger
meaningfully different paths available to successors
decisions that remain reversible and consented
duplicate proposals avoided without hiding conflicts
benchmark_matrix.challenge: repeat input and inspect preserved history

roles.authority: verify digest and issue bounded ACK

cycle: CoBoogie bounded diverse and replicated tests
CoGlass inspect blind spots and dissent
CoEvo revise or retire failed candidates
break_glass: Pause on privacy, minor safety, identity, credentials, finance, deletion, public release, canon and irreversible authority gates until appropriate human approval and logged recovery.
proof_boundary: This artifact demonstrates only a published design and readback, not a running coordination system, cross-session ACK, child consent, 24h recovery or verified mirrors.
